findings.message: The upper bound pins this helper to Python 3.10 exactly, so `uv run` on a machine that only has 3.11+ will refuse to run the hook (or go download a 3.10 for it). The other prek scripts use an open-ended floor — please make this `>=3.10` unless there is a real 3.11 incompatibility here.

The unreadable-constant branch of check_schema_version is the one behaviour this hook deliberately diverges on from the Java sibling (fail instead of implicit pass), and it is the only branch with no test. Please add a case where TS_SUPERVISOR is missing or its declaration no longer matches SCHEMA_VERSION_PATTERN, asserting main() returns 1 and the README is left untouched — otherwise a future tweak to the regex silently turns the check back into a pass.
